_metadata.description: Water costs by country: desalination (SWRO) and municipal/industrial supply (USD/m3)
sources: World Bank IBNET Water Tariff Database
_metadata.notes: Desal prices assume modern large-scale SWRO plants (>50,000 m3/d). Municipal prices are industrial/bulk tariffs. Actual costs vary by volume, contract, and local conditions.

OM.name: Oman
OM.note: Major SWRO capacity (Barka, Sur, Ghubrah); industrial water subsidized

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.note: World's largest desal capacity; SWPC contracts at $0.50-0.70/m3

AE.name: UAE
AE.note: Shifting from MSF to SWRO; Taweelah IWP at $0.55/m3

QA.name: Qatar
QA.note: MSF/MED dominant; Ras Abu Fontas expansion

KW.name: Kuwait
KW.note: Heavily subsidized municipal water; Az-Zour SWRO $0.60/m3

BH.name: Bahrain
BH.note: Al Dur SWRO plant; small-scale industrial supply

JO.name: Jordan
JO.note: Water-scarce; Aqaba-Amman desal pipeline planned; high distribution costs

IQ.name: Iraq
IQ.note: Freshwater from Tigris/Euphrates; heavily subsidized; no desal needed

IR.name: Iran
IR.note: Subsidized; southern coast desal expansion; freshwater scarce in central/east

MA.name: Morocco
MA.note: Casablanca desal plant (largest in Africa); Dakhla planned for green H2

EG.name: Egypt
EG.note: Nile water cheap; Red Sea coast desal for industrial zones

DZ.name: Algeria
DZ.note: 13 SWRO plants; municipal water heavily subsidized

LY.name: Libya
LY.note: Great Man-Made River project; desal limited; water near-free

ZA.name: South Africa
ZA.note: Cape Town drought drove desal investment; municipal rising fast

NA_COUNTRY.name: Namibia
NA_COUNTRY.note: Erongo desal; NamWater bulk tariff; arid conditions

KE.name: Kenya
KE.note: Mombasa desal planned; Nairobi water tariffs rising

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.note: Freshwater available; municipal supply unreliable; self-supply common

ET.name: Ethiopia
ET.note: Freshwater abundant (Blue Nile); very low tariffs

GH.name: Ghana
GH.note: Teshie-Nungua desal; Ghana Water Company tariffs

CL.name: Chile
CL.note: Mining drives desal in Atacama; cheapest SWRO in LatAm; municipal tiered

BR.name: Brazil
BR.note: Abundant freshwater; Sabesp/Copasa tariffs; NE Brazil has brackish desal

AR.name: Argentina
AR.note: Freshwater abundant; heavily subsidized water tariffs

UY.name: Uruguay
UY.note: OSE state utility; freshwater but drought risk

PY.name: Paraguay
PY.note: Abundant water (Parana/Paraguay rivers); ESSAP tariffs very low

MX.name: Mexico
MX.note: Baja California SWRO; CONAGUA tariffs vary by state

AU.name: Australia
AU.note: Perth/Sydney/Melbourne desal plants; water pricing among highest globally

IN_COUNTRY.name: India
IN_COUNTRY.note: Chennai/Gujarat desal; industrial tariffs low; groundwater depletion issue

JP.name: Japan
JP.note: Fukuoka desal; municipal tariffs vary by prefecture

VN.name: Vietnam
VN.note: Freshwater from Mekong; industrial tariffs 8,000-12,000 VND/m3

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.note: PDAM tariffs; Java water stress driving desal interest

MY.name: Malaysia
MY.note: Freshwater abundant; heavily subsidized IWK tariffs

SG.name: Singapore
SG.note: Tuas desal; NEWater reuse; PUB industrial rate $2.74/m3

PK.name: Pakistan
PK.note: Karachi desal projects; inland freshwater heavily subsidized

BD.name: Bangladesh
BD.note: Freshwater abundant (Ganges-Brahmaputra); DWASA tariffs very low

TW.name: Taiwan
TW.note: Heavily subsidized municipal water; Changhua desal planned

KZ.name: Kazakhstan
KZ.note: Freshwater from rivers; Mangistau desal (Caspian); low tariffs

UZ.name: Uzbekistan
UZ.note: Amu Darya/Syr Darya; among lowest tariffs globally

AZ.name: Azerbaijan
AZ.note: Caspian desal potential; Azersu subsidized tariffs

TR.name: Turkey
TR.note: ISKI/ASKi tariffs; Mediterranean coast desal growing

DE.name: Germany
DE.note: Freshwater; among Europe's highest industrial water tariffs

PT.name: Portugal
PT.note: Algarve desal planned; AdP group tariffs

DK.name: Denmark
DK.note: Freshwater; world's highest water taxes (~$3.50 tax/m3)

NO.name: Norway
NO.note: Freshwater abundant; kommunalt vann og avløp

GB.name: Great Britain

CA.name: Canada
CA.note: Freshwater abundant; municipal rates vary by province

US.name: United States
